description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller named HomeController that handles requests to the root URL ('/'). It retrieves the authenticated user, notifications, and contracts associated with the user, and adds these to the model for rendering the 'index' view.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller that manages the home page, fetching user-specific notifications and contracts to display.

methods.name: home
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/', retrieves the authenticated user, notifications, and contracts, and returns the 'index' view.
